item.title: Shimanto River Guide: Canoeing, Cycling, and Japan's Last Wild River
item.description: The Shimanto River flows 194 kilometres from its source in the Shikoku Mountains to the Pacific Ocean at Nakamura City — and it does so without passing through a single dam. It is the only major river in Japan that has never been obstructed along its entire length, a fact that has preserved an aquatic ecosystem of unusual richness and given the river a visual clarity that larger managed rivers have long since lost.
